shorts.title: Is a Pistol Shrimp's Bubble as Hot as the Sun? 🦐
shorts.description:
TRUE or FALSE? This tiny shrimp shoots a bubble almost as hot as the sun. Guess before the timer, then comment if you got it right 👇 

Bonus fact: The snap of a pistol shrimp is one of the loudest sounds in the ocean, louder than a gunshot up close.
